title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The education study concerns feedback on short statistics explanations. The assistant may identify a reasoning gap but must not supply a complete replacement answer. A fluent explanation is not necessarily statistically correct. The task uses anonymized responses and does not assign course grades.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: The proposed sample contains 40 responses to the same question. Feedback will be compared with a rubric-only condition. A response confusing association with causation is a prespecified hard case. The study will assess feedback accuracy and usefulness, not claim improved learning from a single review.
